pdf.form.fillTip: Type into the PDF form fields. Click a field to type; Tab moves to the next field. Turn off to select the page as usual.
pdf.form.xfaTip: This is an XFA form; Omniweave cannot fill it.
pdf.annot.tip.highlight: Drag over text to highlight it. Esc turns it off.
pdf.annot.tip.underline: Drag over text to underline it. Esc turns it off.
pdf.annot.tip.strike: Drag over text to strike it through. Esc turns it off.
pdf.annot.tip.note: Click the page to add a sticky note. Esc turns it off.
pdf.annot.tip.sign: Draw your signature or use a picture of it, then click the page to place it. Click a signature field to fit it there.
pdf.sign.title: Add signature
pdf.sign.drawHint: Sign with the mouse or a pen.
pdf.sign.imageHint: Choose a photo or scan of your signature. The light paper becomes transparent.
pdf.sign.badImage: This picture could not be read.
pdf.find.hint: Finds text on the PDF pages. Enter: next, Shift+Enter: previous
